text: This report is filed regarding the account of Hina Yousaf (CNIC 424341-5552729-7), a student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000, whose activity exhibits classic money mule characteristics. Between May 2 and May 11, 2026, the account received 19 inbound IBFT transfers totaling approximately PKR 936,000 from 15 distinct counterparties across multiple banks, including Areeba Shah, Nimra Farooq, and Bilal Zafar. This volume is grossly inconsistent with the customer's profile and declared income. The funds were rapidly swept out of the account via three large transfers to a QuickPay wallet (WLT****0932) on May 4 (PKR 184,000), May 9 (PKR 151,000), and May 11 (PKR 237,000), as well as a PKR 278,000 ATM withdrawal in Islamabad on May 5. The rapid movement of funds, often within hours of receipt, indicates the account is being used to layer illicit proceeds. Furthermore, the Fraud Desk noted that two sender banks issued fraud recall requests citing scam complaints, confirming the illicit nature of the inbound transfers. The combination of high-volume, multi-source inbound transfers, immediate outbound transfers to digital wallets and cash, and associated fraud complaints strongly suggests the customer is acting as a mule for a cybercrime scheme.
